name: _Organized Desktop/05 Numbered Experiments/zz8

name: _Organized Desktop/08 App And Product Projects/appmakertrack
top_fix: Add a 15-20 term glossary to 02-CONCEPTS.md (compare-and-set, conditional update, zero-rows-as-conflict, seam, injected client, 400 vs 404 vs 409) and a 'known strictness and cost' note covering parseInstant's 3-fraction-digit limit, moveTicket's ~2N updates, and the 400->409 status change.
summary: Best course in the batch. Five Next.js App Router routes refactored from truthiness checks and blind updates into a strict validator plus timer and board services: stop is now a compare-and-set updateMany({id, endTime:null}) with 409 on zero rows, start wraps check+create in a transaction, moveTicket validates the target column's project inside the transaction and rewrites contiguous positions, and safeErrorResponse stops driver messages leaking. 13 tests exercise the real functions; raw test/lint/typecheck/build logs ship inside the course; one course code block is byte-identical to the file it quotes.

name: _Organized Desktop/12 Other Projects/GlobGame
top_fix: Put code in the course: all nine chapters contain zero code blocks (grep -c '```' = 0 everywhere) and no file:line anchors. Inline updatePuzzle (src/lib/puzzles/authoring.js:95-122), the 409 mapping, and the trigger-based rollback test, and turn 06-SOLUTIONS-AND-REVIEW.md into actual solutions.
summary: Exemplary CRUD code, prose-only course. Astra added a whole authoring feature to a client-only puzzle game: bearer-gated /api/studio routes, a validator, optimistic concurrency via a version column and conditional updateMany, publication immutability and archive/delete lifecycle rules, RepeatableRead paginated listing, a real migration, an idempotent seed, and an audit table deliberately modelled without a foreign key so rows survive deletion. Verified by 34 model + 10 real-PostgreSQL + 9 Chromium tests with raw logs and screenshots shipped. But the nine chapters contain no code at all, no solutions, and practice tasks 3-5 (accounts, idempotency receipts, outbox) are senior work with no scaffolding.

name: _Organized Desktop/12 Other Projects/jdtrrain2.1
top_fix: Move the inline 'The solution is...' paragraphs out of 05-PRACTICE.md into 06-SOLUTIONS-AND-REVIEW.md so the exercises can actually be attempted; also remove the duplicated toPosition validation in move/route.js:21-23 now that boundedInsertAt owns that boundary.
summary: Tight, honest course on the three bugs that break real PATCH endpoints: unvalidated field types, relations never scoped to the caller's project, and side effects written outside the transaction that owns the update. The fix adds one input helper, a client=prisma parameter on createIssueActivity so activity and notification rows join the issue update in one $transaction, enum/relation/no-op validation on PATCH, whole-set validation before bulk sprint writes, and a ClientError class so only 4xx messages reach the client. Eleven tests load the real route modules via vm.SourceTextModule; VERIFICATION volunteers what is still broken (move activity outside its transaction, no expected-version check).

name: aiheartbeat
top_fix: Add a second exercise that actually improves CRUD behaviour rather than hardening it - implement practice exercise 4's versioned import in packages/dashboard/lib/workspace-store.ts with all-or-nothing transaction semantics, id remapping and per-row validation plus tests; right now the most interesting task is the only unimplemented one.
summary: A small, careful, scrupulously honest lesson. The whole delta is two guard functions (assertCollection via hasOwnProperty, assertId via Number.isSafeInteger) in one file, because the collection name is interpolated into a SQLite table name and SQL parameters cannot stand in for identifiers; the regression fires __proto__, constructor and a DROP TABLE string at save and delete and diffs the whole workspace. Verification is the best in the batch: the 505-test claim matches the shipped log exactly, and the course states the fix is defence in depth rather than a closed exploit and that its own .safe() edit is a no-op under Zod 4. No CRUD behaviour was actually added.

name: buildbusinesses
top_fix: Document the browser suite's command: 15 of the 67 claimed checks come from 'python scripts/verify_browser.py' and grep finds no mention of it (or of Python/Chromium prerequisites) anywhere in astraupskill/*.md - 04-TESTING-AND-DEBUGGING.md lists only npm test/typecheck/lint/build.
summary: A 3,398-line single component taken apart into a Zod schema layer with whole-aggregate invariants (overpayment is rejected by validating the resulting workspace, not by the payment branch), a command reducer gated on an expected revision, a reviewed legacy migration, and an IndexedDB repository whose writes are single transactions with durability:'strict', a workspaceId+revision compare-and-set and resolution on tx.oncomplete. Money is scaled integers, recurrence clamps Jan 31 to Feb 28, foreign keys guard deletes. 52 node tests + 15 Chromium checks with logs and nine screenshots, plus a candid account of two bugs the verification itself found. Entirely client-side: no HTTP, SQL or auth; only three code blocks in nine chapters.

name: lucasrouter
top_fix: Restore the constant reference in tests/store.test.ts - the photo-budget test now hardcodes 'A'.repeat(1_499_960) instead of importing PHOTO_BUDGET_BYTES, so changing the budget silently stops testing the boundary; also loosen or document the strict data-URL photo regex that silently drops legal payloads while recordDelivery still returns ok:true.
summary: A sharp, narrow lesson on the gap between TypeScript types and runtime values: a 48-line deliveryValidation module with enum guards and a sanitizer that trims/bounds names at 120 and notes at 500 and accepts photos only as data URLs, wired into two zustand mutations so an unknown failure reason is rejected before any write while malformed optional fields are dropped - and the course explains why those two policies differ. Also fixed a real production-build failure by scoping Tailwind source discovery. evidence.json records per-gate commands, exit codes and durations and explicitly refuses to count typecheck/lint/build among the 222 cases. The contribution is small next to mostly pre-existing tests, and everything is browser-local.

name: _Organized Desktop/02 Build Projects/buildCRMPYJS
top_fix: Add one CRUD chapter - the Prisma schema already has CRM models, so implement a single owned resource end to end (GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/contacts with Zod validation, a role/ownership check using the now-trustworthy role claim, pagination, 403 vs 404) with its own exercises; the course currently teaches the gate but never the house.
summary: The most valuable bug in the batch. Public registration accepted a caller-supplied role, so anyone could register as SYSTEM_ADMIN; the fix rejects the field at the Zod boundary AND hardcodes READ_ONLY in the service, with a test that calls the service directly to prove the second layer. It also caught that the Express error handler had three parameters and therefore never ran, pinned JWT verification to HS256 with real claim parsing (refresh-token-as-access and a role:'ROOT' claim now rejected), bound refresh records to their token subject, scoped logout by userId, and turned the register read-then-write race into a single 409 via Prisma P2002. Nine Supertest tests against the real app with a hoisted Prisma mock; logs shipped. Caveat: this repo has no CRUD entity routes at all.
